title: Interior and boot space
summary: Feedback on space centers on generally roomy cabin and boot areas, while some reviews mention reduced luggage capacity or a cramped interior.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise generous cabin room and useful boot capacity.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain about reduced boot space from the mild-hybrid battery and an interior that feels too small.

undetermined.summary: Many undetermined fragments mention space, boot room, battery-related boot reduction, or parking-space context, but the sample does not consistently show explicit sentiment labels for them.

limitations: Most sampled fragments in this topic are undetermined, limiting confidence in a sentiment-only reading of space feedback.
